summary: This comprehensive beginner guide covers fundamental mechanics and early game strategy in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. Creator Skratch explains how seasonal elemental affinity pairings work, how hero damage dealers differ between direct (Crit/Attack) and derivative (Enlightenment) scaling, and how to build synergistic teams around specific damage schools. He breaks down summoning banner rules, emphasizing pity management and why players must save 300 Heliolite Dice before pulling on exclusive banners. Additionally, he outlines daily stamina spending priorities, shop buying guides for spenders and F2P, island base upgrades, and the top Mythic Artifacts to buy first.

meta_changes: Seasonal element pairing: Two elemental affinities are combined into one shared affinity bonus each season (e.g., Wildfire combines Fire and Poison).
Skill Haste serves as the game's speed stat, reducing battle skill and ultimate cooldown times rather than turn order.
Damage scaling splits into direct damage (Attack + Crit) and derivative damage (Attack + Enlightenment).
tips: Never pull on limited or selectable banners without having at least 270 to 300 Heliolite Dice reserved to guarantee the selector hero at 300 pulls.
Purchase 2 daily stamina refills (60 stamina each for 150 Wyrmarrow total) every single day to maintain steady account progression.
Do not farm gear dungeons in the early game; push to the highest stage possible once, then spend stamina on Goblin Lair and Talent dungeons instead.
Prioritize purchasing Witch's Remains as your first Mythic Artifact from the shop for its essential Defense Penalty II debuff.
Gatekeeper's Staff is the second recommended shop artifact to buy, converting overhealing into team shields and boosting Skill Haste.
Never exchange exclusive hero duplicate soul imprints for generic Mythic Artifacts; save them for that hero's Exclusive Artifact or Inspiration.
In the Psychicore mastery tree, focus on maxing nodes for your primary two elemental affinities rather than spreading points across all elements.
Prioritize upgrading your support heroes' skills before DPS heroes so their healing and buff rotations keep the team alive.
